review_notes: Independently read the complete top-level proposal.json, functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json, and link-dispositions.json. The reviewed proposal contains ten fact writes, all for owned function subjects, and no entity, merge, follow-up, or link mutations.

Read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered form and enumerated all 39 subjects, 64 baseline facts, and 22 outgoing links. Rendered substitutions were not treated as evidence of meaning.

All ten proposed writes are supported by canonical implementation and inspected foreign definitions or callers. The negative-index correction, returning-void correction, event-nullability correction, stored-byte classifier provenance, pre-instance-gate notification, ID-only item arguments, and fighter-owned final marker are justified.

Independently verified the previously deferred 0x9B relationship: pl_8003EA40 rejects nonzero victim flag or unequal victim player/event xC, then calls pl_80038824 with 0x9B; the latter increments the indexed decision counter.
Acceptance does not establish compiled section placement, object overlays, high-ID storage safety, meteor identity, or motion-resource semantics. These remain explicitly deferred below.

Two retained item-function claims and the availability game-mapping claim are more broadly worded than their established evidence. Their unsupported portions are specifically deferred in the independent dispositions rather than accepted as proved; no additional write is required to accept the ten submitted changes.
No source, database, shared artifact, or public-message mutations were performed.

unresolved: All nine section-subject facts remain unresolved: compiled .data/.sdata2 membership, extents, assertion-string placement, pooling, and alignment are not established by source.

pl_80037C60 indexes declared by_attack_hi[65] with IDs at least 100. Intended storage semantics and compiled destinations remain unresolved; the source expression is not a proved valid extended counter table.

Struct2070 integer reinterpretation, UnkPlBonusBits writes, Struct2074/event overlays, item-event compatibility, and Fighter-to-HSD_GObj** casting have no compiled layout or aliasing proof in this review.
fn_80037F00 passes the victim's stored attack byte to a motion-state classifier. Actual side-attack gameplay meaning and any intentional relationship between those integer domains remain unproved.

Meteor identity, active angle-window values, and complete x2084_b0 reset lifetime remain unresolved. The verified predicate is inclusive, unsigned, and excludes 361; the notification occurs during hitbox setup.

The owned-item contact adapter supplies the item's attack-ID byte, not the owner's current metadata or a full classification word. Stronger owner-current-identity and full-category claims in facts 024ea8cb-f7f5-4fc1-96d9-4012eaa8acaa and dbe78226-cb10-41bb-ba9c-9e8b6a77a0eb are specifically deferred.
Motion descriptor x8 is tested for nonzero, but its exact archive-size/resource-presence semantics remain unproved, including the stronger wording in fact de824fea-2412-4038-815f-902c9e13b578.
Unknown category bits, motion 0xFD, numeric attack ranges, and bonus display names remain unmapped beyond verified numeric behavior.

Global table immutability, reset consistency, unique-per-occurrence filtered credit, and permanent filtered<=attempts or monotonicity invariants are not established. Counters are unsigned and unsaturated.
Exceptional and out-of-range percentage-to-int conversion has no established portable integer result. Actual target conversion behavior is unverified; no sanitization occurs.
The optional motion-entry callback executes before attack counting and is then cleared by the foreign caller. This TU does not own its lifetime or establish all possible callback effects.
